title: EvaluationRecord
description: The output of twgt-bridge evaluate(). Reports whether collected evidence is EVIDENCE_READY or HELD, with one entry per check that ran. This is not an admission decision. Admission is a human act performed by the consuming repository.

state.description: EVIDENCE_READY when every check passed. HELD when any check failed, returned inconclusive, or could not run.

reason.description: Aggregate reason. ALL_CHECKS_PASSED when state is EVIDENCE_READY. The reason of the first HELD check when state is HELD.

checks.description: One entry per evaluation step that ran, in the order performed.

age_seconds.description: Present only for time-based checks (FRESH, STALE_EVIDENCE).

detail.description: Optional structured detail. Present on API_ERROR and UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION.
Optional structured detail on the aggregate result.
